(☉ㅅ☉U)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 26 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|New fast enemy incoming!|Beginning of Wave 26 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]] & [[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Shock''', originally named the '''Lightning''', is a very fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]]. It is noticeably faster than most enemies in the game. They have the same amount of health as the old [[Molten]], meaning that they are a dangerous threat. The '''Shock''' can be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode from wave 27 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The fifth version of '''Shock''' was identical to its fourth version, except it is faceless. It plays a popping sound whilst emitting green question mark particles on death. |Version 4 |The fourth version of the '''Shock''' was slightly smaller than an average enemy. It had glowing yellow skin. Its torso and legs were glowing light yellow. It had a lightning bolt symbol on its torso. It had grey diamond-plated armbands on both its arms. Yellow sparks were emitted from its torso and arms. It had a sad face. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Shock''' had glowing yellow skin, its torso and legs were golden, and it had a lightning bolt symbol on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face. Yellow sparks were emitted from its head and arms. When running, its animation was similar to that of a Naruto Run. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Shock''' had glowing yellow skin, its torso was yellow, its legs were dark-ish yellow, and it had a lightning bolt symbol on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face. Yellow sparks were emitted from its torso. When running, its animation was similar to that of a Naruto Run. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Shock''' had glowing yellow skin, its torso and legs were white, and it had a lightning bolt decal on its torso. It had a block head and a drooling zombie face. Yellow sparks were emitted its torso. }} ==Strategy== *Using towers that can slow down the '''Shock''', such as the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]] and [[Warden]], is highly recommended. **Be wary that due to its fast speed, [[Sledger]]s may occasionally miss their swings. **Because of its high damage, a few Level 4-5 [[Electroshocker]]s can be used to easily kill multiple '''Shocks'''. *Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]], can be useful against '''Shocks''', as they mostly spawn in groups. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tanks]] and [[Railgun Tank]]s can absorb damage from damaged '''Shocks''' pretty easily while also being able to damage them. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], or [[Accelerator]] can easily take out hordes of '''Shocks'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} NewShock.png|Fourth version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) Shock-0.png|Third version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) Lightning-0.png|Second version (15 July 2019 – 13 October 2019) Lightning0.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 15 July 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} Shock_Corpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Shock''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ShockIconIG.png|'''Shock''' on its icon. }} ==Trivia== *The original name and appearance was similar to an [[Enemies|enemy]] from ''Tower Battles'', the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Lightning|Lightning]]. *When the [[Super Mystery]] and [[Uber Mystery]] was in the game, they had a chance of spawning the '''Shock''', upon their death, in [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]], [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. *When killed, the '''Shock''' left behind the same particles the [[Mystery]] does. The '''Shock''' also had the same death sound as the [[Mystery]]. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''14 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.0|BETA v1.0.0]] **'''Lightning''' added. *'''10 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.4|BETA v1.4.0]] **Health increased from 85 to 90. *'''15 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.5|BETA v1.5.0]] **Appearance changed. *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **Speed increased. ***Speed was later slightly decreased (8). **Health increased from 90 to 120. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Appearance changed. **Renamed from ''Lightning'' to ''Shock''. **Health decreased from 120 to 100. **Now spawns in Normal mode (now [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode). *'''14 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.1]] **Now has [[Partial Electric Immunity]]. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Appearance changed. **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] removed. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **Appearance changed. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **{{Bug}} Now emits the [[Mystery]]'s death particles on death. *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Shock''' removed. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.4]] **'''Shock''' now appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode, if activated through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.5]] **'''Shock''' no longer appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode, as it has been removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3a]] **'''Shock''' now appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode, if activated through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. }} {{LegacyMolten|[[Hidden Boss]]|Wave 24|Shock|Wave 26|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 30}} {{Easy|[[Hidden Boss]]|Wave 22|Lightning|Wave 26|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
